quotes.text: Renting a boat with Kelowna Boat Charters was a great experience. Rental process was quick and easy - found last minute availability online and it was super easy to select a boat and confirm our reservation. Jonny was quick to respond to any questions and special requests we had. We rented a pontoon boat and it was clean and in great condition and perfect for our young family. Pickup and drop off of the boat was super easy. Made for the perfect day on the lake! Would absolutely recommend!

Jonny and Jordan were great to deal with. We rented a Nautique for surfing and then the Fun ship pontoon boat 2 days later. Beautiful boats and such great memories were made. Jonny was a fabulous host and so friendly. We rented from this company last year and again this year. Next year we will rent from him again!! No need to look any further for a company to rent boats from. This is it!!! You won’t be disappointed I promise. Thanks Jonny for being such great guy to deal with!!

Our family rented a pontoon / party boat on our annual week long trip to Kelowna. Sadly the weather didn’t turn out for the day we selected and the voyage didnt last as long as expected. The way the situation was handled we appreciated. They were able to refund our booking and were very apologetic for something they couldn’t control. Definitely a family run business where they care and we will be sure to book with them in the future and hope for less wind and more sun!

I can’t say enough good things about this boat company. Start to finish, the process was seamless but the best part was how accommodating everyone was and how they went above and beyond. They answered my never ending questions and found solutions to all our potential problems. Huge shout out to our captain Max, who was not only super professional but also had 10/10 vibes to match our group very well. We cannot wait to book with you guys again, thank you for everything!

Our group is still talking about how fantastic our rental was over the long weekend. We got a pontoon charter and Jake was our driver and we LOVED him. He was what made the experience so great. He was patient and fun and even got a new ladder delivered to us in the middle of the lake since the one was missing from the boat. He did an amazing job putting up with a bunch of women LOL. Thanks again Jake!!!

Amazing experience 10/10 will recommend to all our friends. It was super easy to book through their website. Instructions were very clear on where to meet them. The boat was in water and ready to go when we arrived and the staff was super friendly. We had a great day on the lake! Their communication is prompt and amazing. Prices are very reasonable. Will definitely book with them again. Highly recommend
